name: feedback.tools Customer Surveys
author: feedbacktools

sections.description:
feedback.tools Customer Surveys asks your WooCommerce customers two questions right after they buy: how satisfied they are (CSAT) and how they heard about your store (HDYHAU). The surveys show on the order confirmation page, and each answer is linked to its order. A third, General survey works on any page of any WordPress site. Turn each survey on or off separately. All answers stay in your WordPress database, and the results are in your WordPress admin.

CSAT (customer satisfaction)

  • Customers rate their purchase on a 1–5 scale on the WooCommerce order confirmation page.
  • Choose emoji faces, stars or numbers, and set the labels for both ends of the scale.
  • Add an optional follow-up question with a free-text answer.
  • Results: CSAT score (share of scores 4 and 5), average score, number of responses and a breakdown by score.

HDYHAU (“How did you hear about us?”)

  • Customers pick where they heard about your store on the WooCommerce order confirmation page.
  • Set the options and their order. Add an optional “Other” option with a free-text answer.
  • Results: a pie chart and a list of options with the count and share of each.

General survey

  • An open question with a free-text answer or a choice of options.
  • Shows at the end of the pages you choose. You can also place it anywhere with the [feedback_tools_survey] shortcode.
  • Results: a list of all answers.

Each survey has its own question, thank you message and an Active / Draft status. Visitors see only active surveys. Each results screen has a date filter.

CSAT and HDYHAU answers are linked to the WooCommerce order, so you can open the order from the results screen. One order gets one answer per survey.

Without WooCommerce

The General survey works on any WordPress site. CSAT and HDYHAU need WooCommerce, because they show after a purchase. Without WooCommerce they are not available in the admin.

Privacy

The plugin does not connect to external services and does not send data outside your site. It stores survey settings and answers in its own tables in your WordPress database. It does not store names, emails or IP addresses. A CSAT or HDYHAU answer stores the WooCommerce order ID. Free-text answers contain whatever the visitor types.

Credits

Emoji icons are from Sensa Emoji by sensadesign, MIT license.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add Plugin, or upload the feedback-tools-surveys folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Surveys → Settings, set up a survey and set its status to Active.
  4. For the General survey, choose the pages where it shows, or add the [feedback_tools_survey] shortcode to a page or post.
  5. See the answers in Surveys → Results.
sections.faq:
Where do CSAT and HDYHAU surveys show?

On the WooCommerce order confirmation (“Order received”) page, after a customer places an order. The plugin uses the standard woocommerce_thankyou action, so the surveys show with the classic and the block-based checkout.

Can a customer answer twice for the same order?

No. After a customer answers, the survey no longer shows for that order.

What happens to the answers when I remove an option?

Old answers keep the option label. The results screen marks the option as removed.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

When you delete the plugin from the Plugins screen, it removes its tables and settings. Deactivation keeps all data.
